description: This file contains implementation code related to Bloom filters within a Git-related project. It defines functions for managing, loading, and utilizing bloom filters for commit graph optimization, including hash functions, filter initialization, and checks.

classes.name: struct pathmap_hash_entry
classes.description: A hash map entry for storing a filesystem path and its associated data within the bloom filter context.

classes.name: struct bloom_filter
classes.description: A data structure representing a Bloom filter used for efficient set membership testing in commit graph optimization.

classes.name: struct bloom_key
classes.description: A structure holding hash values for a bloom filter key, used to add paths to Bloom filters.

classes.name: struct bloom_keyvec
classes.description: A vector of bloom keys representing multiple hierarchical paths derived from a given filesystem path.

methods.name: uint32_t rotate_left(uint32_t value,int32_t count)
methods.description: Performs a bitwise rotate left operation on a 32-bit unsigned integer.

methods.name: unsigned char get_bitmask(uint32_t pos)
methods.description: Returns a bitmask corresponding to a position within a word for setting or checking bits.

methods.name: int check_bloom_offset(struct commit_graph * g,uint32_t pos,uint32_t offset)
methods.description: Verifies if a given offset is within the valid range for Bloom filter data in a commit graph.

methods.name: int load_bloom_filter_from_graph(struct commit_graph * g,struct bloom_filter * filter,uint32_t graph_pos)
methods.description: Loads a bloom filter from a commit graph at a specified position, used to reconstruct filter data.

methods.name: uint32_t murmur3_seeded_v2(uint32_t seed,const char * data,size_t len)
methods.description: Computes the Murmur3 hash (version 2) for given data and seed, producing a uniform hash value.

methods.name: uint32_t murmur3_seeded_v1(uint32_t seed,const char * data,size_t len)
methods.description: Computes the Murmur3 hash (version 1) for given data and seed, producing a uniform hash value.

methods.name: void bloom_key_fill(struct bloom_key * key,const char * data,size_t len,const struct bloom_filter_settings * settings)
methods.description: Fills a bloom key with hash values computed from input data using specified filter settings.

methods.name: void bloom_key_clear(struct bloom_key * key)
methods.description: Clears the hashes within a bloom key.

methods.name: void add_key_to_filter(const struct bloom_key * key,struct bloom_filter * filter,const struct bloom_filter_settings * settings)
methods.description: Adds a bloom key to a bloom filter by setting bits according to the key's hash values.

methods.name: void init_bloom_filters(void)
methods.description: Initializes the global Bloom filter slab used within the project.

methods.name: void free_one_bloom_filter(struct bloom_filter * filter)
methods.description: Frees the memory associated with a single bloom filter.

methods.name: void deinit_bloom_filters(void)
methods.description: Deinitializes and cleans up all Bloom filters managed by the slab.

methods.name: struct:bloom_keyvec * bloom_keyvec_new(const char * path,size_t len,const struct bloom_filter_settings * settings)
methods.description: Creates a new bloom key vector from a filesystem path, breaking it into hierarchical components.

methods.name: void bloom_keyvec_free(struct bloom_keyvec * vec)
methods.description: Frees the memory allocated for a bloom key vector.

methods.name: int pathmap_cmp(const void * hashmap_cmp_fn_data UNUSED,const struct hashmap_entry * eptr,const struct hashmap_entry * entry_or_key,const void * keydata UNUSED)
methods.description: Comparison function for pathmap hashmap entries based on paths.

methods.name: void init_truncated_large_filter(struct bloom_filter * filter,int version)
methods.description: Creates a placeholder Bloom filter for very large or truncated filters.

methods.name: int has_entries_with_high_bit(struct repository * r,struct tree * t)
methods.description: Recursively checks if a tree or its entries contain paths with high-bit set characters.

methods.name: int commit_tree_has_high_bit_paths(struct repository * r,struct commit * c)
methods.description: Checks if a commit's tree contains paths with high-bit bytes.

methods.name: struct:bloom_filter * upgrade_filter(struct repository * r,struct commit * c,struct bloom_filter * filter,int hash_version)
methods.description: Upgrades a bloom filter to a newer hash version if possible, considering high-bit paths.

methods.name: struct:bloom_filter * get_bloom_filter(struct repository * r,struct commit * c)
methods.description: Retrieves the bloom filter associated with a given commit, loading from graph if necessary.

methods.name: struct:bloom_filter * get_or_compute_bloom_filter(struct repository * r,struct commit * c,int compute_if_not_present,const struct bloom_filter_settings * settings,enum bloom_filter_computed * computed)
methods.description: Retrieves or computes a bloom filter for a commit, possibly upgrading or generating from path changes.

methods.name: int bloom_filter_contains(const struct bloom_filter * filter,const struct bloom_key * key,const struct bloom_filter_settings * settings)
methods.description: Checks whether a bloom filter contains a specific key.

methods.name: int bloom_filter_contains_vec(const struct bloom_filter * filter,const struct bloom_keyvec * vec,const struct bloom_filter_settings * settings)
methods.description: Checks if a bloom filter contains all keys in a given vector.

methods.name: uint32_t test_bloom_murmur3_seeded(uint32_t seed,const char * data,size_t len,int version)
methods.description: Performs a hash test using Murmur3, supporting different versions.
